sealed_record.thesis: Applied Optoelectronics ($AAOI) is the more-consensus expression of the same optical-interconnect scarcity: it explicitly cited a +20-40% demand imbalance for transceivers with lasers as the bottleneck, and noted it had no meaningful participation in first-gen CPO deployments because its lasers are being allocated to transceivers -- a signal that demand is outrunning its own supply. Stacked with the US proposal to ban Chinese transceiver suppliers (Innolight/Eoptolink) and GlobalWafers' acknowledged wafer shortage, AAOI has a clean capacity-demand-absorption tailwind into AI datacenter buildout. This is a sharper, more-covered catalyst-driven name than SIVE, hence a leveraged long expression rather than accumulation.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -58.8%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind: skandal dan pencopotan Jensen Huang (8 Nov), aturan sementara ekspor chip AI dari Departemen Perdagangan AS (16 Nov). Long AI/semikonduktor 0 dari 12 untung.
